assumptions.text: Frozen set is the union of test files across all T0 commits; the existing tests/ and test_e\d+ filter is unchanged.
An example counts as named by a frozen test if `test_<id>_` (lower-case) appears in the frozen file's path or content. This matches the selector `run_checks` uses.
The late T0 reuses the task id `T0` and the same attempts, reviewer and vacuity checks as the first T0.

The H1 marker is the newest commit whose subject starts `spec(<slice>): approved at H1`. The build marker is the newest commit whose subject starts `build(<slice>): `, so the last build commit ends the H1 → build phase and starts Build → accept.
Every duration, including lead time, runs to the moment accept writes the page (now). All durations print as hours with one decimal.
The brief commit is the oldest commit that adds `<spec_dir>/brief.md`.
The fallback when there is no brief commit is the first commit in `main..HEAD`, then `report['started']`, then now. Only the first is exercised by the tests.
